material_events.claim: Royalty Pharma completed the Internalization by acquiring all equity interests of RP Manager from the Sellers, transitioning from external management to internal management.
quotes: We completed the acquisition of RP Manager on May 16, 2025.

material_events.claim: The FDA approved Revolution Medicines' Rasonque (daraxonrasib) for the treatment of adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
quotes: In August 2026, Revolution Medicines announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved Rasonque for the treatment of adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy.

material_events.claim: The FDA approved Teva's Weltruza (olanzapine LAI) for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults.
quotes: In October 2026, Teva Pharmaceuticals (Teva) announced that the FDA approved Weltruza for extended-release injectable suspension, a new, once-monthly, subcutaneous long-acting injectable (LAI) for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults.

material_events.claim: The FDA approved Ziihera in combination with chemotherapy for the first-line treatment of adults with metastatic HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.
quotes: In August 2026, Jazz Pharmaceuticals announced that the FDA approved Ziihera in combination with chemotherapy, with or without tislelizumab, for the first-line treatment of adults with metastatic human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.

material_events.claim: The FDA approved Takeda's Mimrylo (rusfertide) for the treatment of erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera.
quotes: In August 2026, Takeda announced that the FDA approved Mimrylo, a hepcidin mimetic peptide, for the treatment of erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera.

material_events.claim: Amgen announced positive Phase 3 results for Imdelltra as a first-line maintenance therapy for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, meeting its primary endpoint of overall survival.
quotes: In September 2026, Amgen announced positive results from the Phase 3 DeLLphi-305 study of Imdelltra in combination with Imfinzi as first-line maintenance treatment for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. The study met its primary endpoint at a pre-specified interim analysis, demonstrating a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival, and also met secondary endpoints of progression-free survival and objective response rate.

material_events.claim: Pharvaris announced positive results from the CHAPTER-3 pivotal Phase 3 study of deucrictibant extended-release for the prevention of hereditary angioedema attacks, meeting all efficacy endpoints.
quotes: In September 2026, Pharvaris announced positive results from the CHAPTER-3 pivotal Phase 3 study evaluating deucrictibant extended-release for the prevention of hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks. The primary endpoint and all secondary efficacy endpoints were met with statistical significance.

material_events.claim: Royalty Pharma acquired a royalty on Arcutis Biotherapeutics' Zoryve for $100 million and a royalty on Takeda's Mimrylo for $100 million in the third quarter of 2026.
quotes: Acquired a royalty on Arcutis Biotherapeutics' Zoryve for $100 million and on Takeda's Mimrylo for $100 million.

material_events.claim: Royalty Pharma funded the required first $250 million tranche of the up to $750 million senior secured term loans to Revolution Medicines following the FDA approval of Rasonque.
quotes: In October 2026, Royalty Pharma funded the required first $250 million tranche of the up to $750 million senior secured term loans to Revolution Medicines.

material_events.claim: GSK completed its acquisition of Nuvalent for approximately $10.6 billion, including Jideytro and neladalkib, two ROS1 and ALK inhibitors for non-small cell lung cancer on which Royalty Pharma holds royalties.
quotes: In July 2026, GSK announced that it completed the acquisition of Nuvalent for approximately $10.6 billion, including Jideytro and neladalkib, two highly selective ROS1 and anaplastic lymphoma kinase inhibitors for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.
